caption: The drawing depicts a single chair centered on a plain, off-white background. The chair has a wooden frame painted in a dark color, likely black, with decorative greenish-yellow floral designs applied to the top three horizontal slats of the backrest, as well as on the chair’s legs and joints. The backrest features three curved slats, each adorned with different floral patterns. The seat of the chair is constructed from what appears to be woven straw or rush, and is colored a bright yellow shade. The chair has a simple, rectangular construction with four legs and supporting horizontal rungs near the base. The style and coloring are consistent throughout the depiction, and the image appears to be a technical or illustrative drawing, as suggested by the presence of a measured scale (“Scale 2 1/2" = 1'”) written in the lower right corner.
title: Ladderback Chair
